result.description: A fictional desktop memory kit designed for compact creative workstations and quiet office builds. The Aster Loom module pair uses DDR5 technology, low-profile heat spreaders, and a restrained ivory finish for systems that prioritize clean aesthetics and efficient multitasking over gaming or storage use. This 24GB kit is intended for dual-channel operation on compatible motherboards.
result.title: Aster Loom 24GB DDR5 Memory Kit Ivory
